botcomponent.description: Use this skill whenever the user asks to write, generate, or create a podcast script or podcast episode — from a topic, or from source material such as a news digest, newsletter, email review, or set of articles — and optionally convert it to audio with Azure Text-to-Speech. Handles the initial request and every follow-up refinement (source, topic, length, cast, narration) in the same task.
botcomponent.name: generating-podcast-script
